g.text: NATURAL DRAFT FIRED HEATER VER 1 · OPERATOR TRAINING SIMULATOR
H-100 NATURAL-DRAFT FIRED HEATER — FEED PREHEAT AND HEATING TO V-200
1. Flows in kg/h; temperatures in °C; pressures in kPa gauge.
